sense.text:
“And I looked, and, lo, a Lamb stood on the mount Sion, and with him an hundred forty and four thousand”: this continues from last week, when Revelation 7 was gone through. Mount Sion is Israel.

“Having his Father’s name written in their foreheads”: every week an email comes in with a new name of God. Everybody is arguing with everybody, condemning you if you don’t say it the way their camp says it; two camps in Texas almost got into a fist fight over the name of the Most High. Israelites are turning into Bloods and Crips over a name. But the scripture says the Father’s name is written on them when they overcome: he is going to give us the pure language, that we may all call upon the Lord with one consent, when he allures us into the wilderness. So in IUIC we don’t bug out on the name. If a brother says Yahawah or Yahawashi or Yahweh, there is nothing wrong with that; don’t bug out on it.

“And they sung as it were a new song before the throne”: the elect sing the song of Moses and the song of the Lamb. It is none of these gospel songs you hear today, Kirk Franklin or James Cleveland; that is not the new song. It gives you goosebumps, but it ain’t the word of God; it just makes you feel good.

“And no man could learn that song but the hundred and forty and four thousand”: the 144,000 will be teachers. They are the leaders, able to teach precept upon precept, line upon line, here a little and there a little, like nobody else. Only the 144 will be able to learn that song. “Which were redeemed from the earth.”

“These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins”: if you are under your woman’s skirt, you are not of the elect; God can’t use you. We are the virgins because all our sins have been wiped away clean; we are the female, the her of Hosea 2 that the Lord allures.

“These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth”: everybody says I follow the Lamb wherever he goes; you are a liar. Christ is not on earth walking with us, so how do we follow him? Whatever the Bible says, we are going to do. Wherever the Lamb takes us we will obey, even if it hurts, even if we love a brother or a sister so much: because the King said it, I must let you go. That is what the elect will say and apply.

“These were redeemed from among men, being the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb”: think of the high holy days in Leviticus 23, the feast of firstfruits. The firstfruits were the first and best of your crops; the souls of men and women who have dedicated themselves to this truth are the firstfruits, and you will never know until the end.

“And in their mouth was found no guile”: look the word up. Guile is sly or cunning intelligence, craftiness, deviousness, schemes, tricks, ruses, deception, deceit, double-dealing, treachery. You are trying to be slick, scheming, underhanded. That is calling the head of the organization and saying, I would like to apply Matthew 18, and I am going to record you, and a whole group of idiots ran behind that. You wouldn’t go to Christ and say, I have to record you just in case you lie. Matthew 18:15 says tell him his fault between thee and him alone; recording him is not what the scripture says, so you have not followed the Lamb wherever he goes.

“For they are without fault before the throne of God”: how are they without fault? Romans 8:1: “There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.”

precepts.why:
“I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth”: the four winds represent the destruction coming from the militaries of the earth. The angels were given power “to hurt the earth and the sea”; that is the operative word. Regular wind ain’t hurting the earth, so this hurt is talking about destruction, major destruction.

“And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God”: the seal of the living God is the testimonies and the laws. “Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.”

“And there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.” Not all nations are being saved: this is only for the elect, and the 144,000 are the leaders of the twelve tribes of Israel. Of Judah, of Reuben, of Gad were sealed twelve thousand: so we would have to have some idea of who the tribes of Israel are. People say nobody knows who the tribes are; then how would Reuben get sealed? Or else we would be sitting among the Chinese and the Japanese. We know the curses upon the Israelites would be colonialism and slavery; we start there.

“Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.” We are being sealed with the law. It is not enough just to talk about God’s laws; we must apply God’s law. Study, pray, apply: SPA. No matter how difficult it gets, we must do this thing.

“For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind”. That is what we are being sealed with: God’s laws. If you are in here and you don’t believe you have to keep God’s laws, you are in the wrong place.

Those being sealed are not only this generation. Generations before us knew this knowledge, not to the level we have now. This deals with time and understanding. “Behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward”: the waters are the word of God.

“He measured a thousand cubits, and he brought me through the waters; the waters were to the ankles.” The understanding of the word of God was only to the ankles. “Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through the waters; the waters were to the knees”: the understanding of God’s laws came to the knees. Then to the loins. When I came in as a youth, the only law we kept was the beard law; we fellowshipped on the sabbath but still cooked on the sabbath, still bought and sold on the sabbath, and the women wore a dress one day a week.

“And it was a river that I could not pass over: for the waters were risen, waters to swim in”: a time will come when the word of God will fill the earth. Our ancestors who preceded us weren’t where we are today, and the Most High is going to judge them based on the understanding they had at that time, not the same understanding the brothers have today, because it wasn’t open to them.

What are the waters a similitude of? “That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word”. The word of God is the water. Even in the ministry of John the Baptist, the water was symbolic, a similitude; it had no power.

Why do people want to get dipped in water? Because they are wicked as hell. Growing up we went through seven different churches and got baptized seven different times, and it did us no good; we were wicked as hell. She wants to lay in the water and come up, shazam, all holy ghost filled, because she doesn’t want to do what it says. If you were baptized in God’s laws you would show changing.

“Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.” That is what David prayed, and every generation has to pray it. Read four chapters a day and within a year you will have read the entire Bible; by the second and third year you will pick up things you never saw before, though you read them a million times.

“And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah”: because Judah would be the teachers. “And bring him unto his people”: for the Lord to bring Judah to his people, Judah must have an idea who the tribes of Israel are. So don’t let people fool you that nobody knows who they are; that is a lie.

“After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues”: people say that means everybody. No: Revelation 7:9 is talking about those that went into slavery, scattered among all nations. 2 Esdras 2 shows who this great multitude is.

“Behold the number of those that be sealed in the feast of the Lord”: the number of those sealed is 144,000. Ezra is saying the same thing John the Revelator was saying. “Which are departed from the shadow of the world”: departed from sin. “And have received glorious garments of the Lord”: the white robes.

“Take thy number, O Sion”: Sion is another name for Israel. “And shut up those of thine that are clothed in white, which have fulfilled the law of the Lord.” That verifies what the sealing is: it ain’t saying fulfill the hexagram, it ain’t saying fulfill your sexual desire; fulfill the law of the Lord. Study, pray, apply.

“The number of thy children, whom thou longedst for, is fulfilled”: that is the 144. “That thy people, which have been called from the beginning, may be hallowed”: called from the beginning of time, when we were with the Lord in the heavens and he said you will be chosen as my elect, and this group over here will play the devil on earth. We came down into these fleshly bodies, and we are just fulfilling our roles.

“I Esdras saw upon the mount Sion a great people, whom I could not number”: this is Revelation 7:9, and it says on mount Sion, that is Israel. “And they all praised the Lord with songs.”

“Therefore, behold, I will allure her”: the her is the nation of Israel, the elect, not all Israel; two out of three of Israel, the Bible says, must die. Allure means to be powerfully attractive, to entice, seduce, persuade. How is the Lord alluring us? With his word, his laws: this is the attraction, the persuasion. “And bring her into the wilderness”: Ezekiel 20, the wilderness of the people. “And speak comfortably unto her”: he will speak to us face to face and teach us everything from Genesis and beyond.

“And she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt”: we are going to sing when we get the lands of inheritance. “Thou shalt call me Ishi”: Ishi means husband; we will call the Lord our husband. “And shalt call me no more Baali”: Baali translates as my Lord.

“For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.” Whatever language we speak, and whatever name we use to identify the one true God, he is going to take all that away. All the names we have for the Most High God are not pure.

“For then will I turn to the people a pure language”: the operative word is pure. The Hebrew Israelite camps always go to Esau’s Strong’s Concordance and Ben Yehuda’s Hebrew dictionary; it is not pure, the Bible says it is not pure. And the groups that don’t believe in Christ go to the Hebrew to argue that he never existed and there was no J in Hebrew, to get you confused.

“That they may all call upon the name of the Lord, to serve him with one consent”: that is not today. Google the names of God and you will find over ten, everybody arguing. It sounds nice, but it ain’t pure, because the Bible says it ain’t pure.

Here is the proper precept for having the Father’s name written in their foreheads. “Him that overcometh”: overcome your own sins, your trials and tribulations, individual, marital or congregational. “Will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out”: you ain’t going into captivity no more.

“And I will write upon him the name of my God”: he will give you the pure language, the Father’s pure name, when you overcome. People say, no Lord, I got it already, my elder taught me the name. Reading is fundamental.

This goes with the name. “And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.” What is his name? The Word of God. People want a special shazam name that gives them goosebumps; his name is called the Word of God.

Redeemed from the earth: “But now thus saith the Lord that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name”. Notice that the 144 are not going to bug out on a name; they are going to teach the word of God and keep it moving. 2 Esdras says those that were sealed fulfilled the law, not the name.

An example of the new song. “Praise ye the Lord. Sing unto the Lord a new song”. I dare any of you to find a negro singing this, and if negroes ain’t singing it, the Latinos definitely ain’t singing it.

This is included in the new song. “Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand; To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people”. Find me a church alive today singing about getting vengeance on their enemies. The black woman is in the church humming, but she ain’t humming that: not my Jesus, not my white Jesus.

“To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron”: show me a church talking about putting our enemies in yokes of iron. There is no gospel song on earth singing that, from Catholicism to Baptist to Lutheran, Pentecostal, Seventh-day Adventist, Jehovah’s Witness. They are not singing the new song, because they are not of the elect.

“Behold not every body’s beauty, and sit not in the midst of women.” Two types of men hang around groups of women: hungry brothers, because they are trying to get the cookies, and homos, who want your beauty secrets, how you do your makeup, your hair, your nails. Too much hand gesture; if your hands are on your hip you better be tired. “For from garments cometh a moth, and from women wickedness.”

This is not talking about all women in general, because women are part of the elect in the great multitude; this is a particular type of woman God can’t stand. “And I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart is snares and nets”: her mind is always trying to figure a way to trap you away from the body, to keep you from applying the Bible. She nags you, threatens you, is always in your ear. “And her hands as bands: whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her”: this is for the elect; if you want to please the Lord, get the hell away from her. Some of you brothers are scared to bust a move, so you stay with that banshee: a female spirit wailing, warning of an impending death in the house. You walk through the door and here she comes, so you sit in the bar from sun up to sun down.

Remember Adam’s sin: he listened to his wife. Satan said, I can’t come direct to him; if I go through her, he might listen. That’s why the scripture says she is the weaker vessel.

This is for you mama’s boys. “Have her forth without the ranges: and him that followeth her kill with the sword.” God can’t use a man that follows a woman. The order is God, Christ, man, then woman. If a man has a woman as his counselor, there is something wrong with his spirit, and God ain’t using him. This is training time, rehearsal: fix it now.

The precept for they are virgins: “For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.” We are the female, as in Hosea where the Lord says I will allure her. We are the virgins because all our sins have been wiped away. This is not the fake thing women do on the news, putting in an artificial hymen; that is evil and that is the devil.

This is what he means by virgins. “There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit”: who walk not after sin, but after the law in Christ. That is how we are a chaste virgin, because we are doing our best to walk in these laws, and this is how we are without fault before the throne.

“My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me”. Following the Lamb means wherever the shepherd leads, we follow. “And I give unto them eternal life”. Christ is not on earth walking with us, so we follow him by doing whatever the Bible says.

This is what the whole group out in Texas that left got mad at. “Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.” They say, no, I’m grown, you can’t tell me who to talk to. Then you are not of the elect; you do not follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth.

“And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.” If they don’t want to hear the congregation, let them be as heathens and publicans; and Israel did not deal with the heathens and publicans. He’ll say something and you’ll reject it: then you don’t follow Christ wherever he goes.

“Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee”: that is somebody close to you, somebody you love. “Cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.” Romans 16:17, Matthew 18:17 and Matthew 18:8: you don’t want to do what this Bible says, so you are not of the elect, and you look at us like we are the devil.

Some of the two thirds come through these doors and are sitting in the seats right now. “Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven”: they say Lord, Lord because they may be in camps, they know they are Israel. All you Israelites ain’t getting into the kingdom of heaven. “But he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven”: he that follows the Lamb whithersoever he goes.

“Have we not prophesied in thy name?” We used to be in the streets teaching that Israelite stuff, we did videos for you, Lord. “And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.” There comes a burnout: your spirit loses interest in the word of God, you get tired of discipline day after day, you lean toward adultery, toward sin, you join with the brother you know is the devil, the beard comes off. Know your spirit.

“Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.” When we come into this truth we are a kind of firstfruits. The firstfruits were the best of your crops, the first and best.

The souls of men and women who have dedicated themselves to this truth are the firstfruits. “Ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints”. Not addicted to weed, crack cocaine, porn, gluttony or video games: the only thing we are to be addicted to is the ministry of the saints.

People speak great words and you follow after the great words, but that is not what the scripture says. “Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone”. The scripture says you and him alone; a recorder makes a third. So that man has not followed the Lamb wherever he goes: these are not the elect.

Without fault: “Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy”. When we repent of our sins and the Lord knows we are rehearsing the righteous acts, he will present us faultless, and he will do it with exceeding joy, because as servants we have followed the Lamb whithersoever he went: whatever he said, we studied, we prayed, we applied.

sense.text: “And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people”: there you go, people say, it’s for everybody. No. It is saying the same thing Revelation 7:9 said: the gospel is preached to the Israelites scattered among every nation. When you read all nations, your mind goes to democracy, everybody; you have already omitted the prophecies and the histories of God, and gone to the white man. That is where your mind automatically goes, in Satan. This is why the Old Testament and the New Testament go hand in hand; once you separate the old from the new, you are lost in confusion.

“Saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him”: no matter what we do, eating or sleeping, we must always give him glory, honor and praise. “For the hour of his judgment is come”: the Lord prophesied we were going into slavery, and it happened; he says in one hour his judgment will come, and you better believe that is going to happen too. Everything he said has come to pass thus far. If you believe some of the Bible but not all of it, this ain’t for you.

In Liberia a whole church was singing for three hours, songs some negro made up in his house, not biblical songs. Two people raised their hands when asked who has a Bible, and when asked what they learned that day, crickets. Is that what the Lord is looking for?

precepts.why: “And the Lord shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen”: few, because they were killing us.

“And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other”: the Israelites scattered among all people. “And there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone”: Christianity and Islam, the world’s two largest religions. That is the evidence that the Israelites would be scattered from one end of the earth to the other.

Here is more proof. “And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.” Where did these Jews come from? Out of every nation under heaven. How did they get to every nation? Through slavery, Deuteronomy 28:64 and Deuteronomy 4:27. So every nation, kindred and tongue in Revelation 14:6 is where the Israelites were scattered.

What is the hour of his judgment? “Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.” That great city Babylon is America. “And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her”: they got wealthy dealing in America’s trade and commerce, buying and selling, and they lament “when they shall see the smoke of her burning”.

“For in one hour so great riches is come to nought.” That is why the scriptures say what shall it profit a man if he gain the whole world and lose his soul. Everybody wants to be rich, the next Jay-Z, the next Beyoncé; what is it going to profit you when this day comes? All that money comes to nothing. “And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off”: trade goes back to buying and selling.

“Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.” In one hour this place is going to be destroyed: ashes to ashes, dust to dust. That is why we ain’t got time to play with y’all.

“Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world”. That hour of temptation is the hour of judgment, that destruction.

sense.text:
“Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city”: Babylon means confusion, and this would be the top nation on earth. Look at all the Christian commentaries on Revelation: none of them will admit that the United States of America is written in the Bible as Babylon. When God raised up Egypt as the superpower they were mentioned, ancient Babylon was mentioned, Persia and Media were mentioned, the Greeks and the Romans were mentioned; but in these last days America, the mightiest nation on earth, is not mentioned? Babylon the great, that mighty city, is the United States of America.

“Because she made all nations drink of the wine”: wine here is a similitude for lies. “Of the wrath of her fornication”: fornication is not America running around having sex; it is spiritual fornication, idolatry. She made all nations drink of the lies of the wrath of her spiritual fornication. What does America do to deceive all nations? She has political and economic policies set up to keep all nations in check.

precepts.why: To explain wine: “If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine”. Wine is a similitude, a metaphor for lies, for falsehood. This is where the spirit of discernment comes in: in some scriptures wine means literal wine, and in others, like the book of Revelation, it is a similitude for lies.
“For the devising of idols was the beginning of spiritual fornication”. Idolatry is spiritual fornication. So Babylon made all nations drink of the lies of the wrath of her spiritual fornication.

sense.text:
“If any man worship the beast and his image”: the beast is the great red dragon, Esau, the so-called white man, the Caucasian race. His image is the image of Caesar Borgia, which they took from Rome as the new image of Christ to be worshipped.

“And receive his mark in his forehead, or in his hand”: your forehead, because you believe it, your brain is in your forehead; your hand, because you support it. The mark deals with economics, trade and commerce. If any country says to America, I don’t agree with your policy, before they kill you they put a sanction on you, the individual, or an embargo on your entire country, and you are cut off from everything. This is why Africa is so afraid: the European allies have made a pact that they will not buy from them or sell to them.

“The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God”: does wine here mean the lies of the wrath of God? No; this is why precept must be upon precept, rightly dividing the word of truth. This cup of wine is judgment, and we know who is going to drink it: Edom. Babylon made all nations drink of the wine of her fornication, and Babylon is Edom.

“And he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb”: that is some death right there.

“And the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever: and they have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image”: you keep on worshipping that white man, you keep on staying in Christianity, “and whosoever receiveth the mark of his name”: you accept his political policies. There is a spiritual world: when some are translated, they are going to suffer major punishment. Nobody is getting away with nothing. When the bombs hit this place it is going to be like a lake of fire, and their spirits will be held in that fire. Fire is spirit; that is why the angel asked Ezra the weight of a flame.

precepts.why: Who is the beast? “And behold a great red dragon”. God didn’t put that adjective there for no reason. People read the great red dragon and think there are monsters in it; stop.
“I am a brother to dragons”: dragons are wicked people. That is what Job says.
Who is the red brother? “And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.” That is the so-called white man, the Caucasian race.

What is his image? The Bible explains it. “And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles”: the verse above talks about the dropping of the atom bombs. “Which he had power to do in the sight of the beast”: the beast is his European allies. “That they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live”: an image to the white man. Rome fell in 193 AD, and came back in power around 1453, the Renaissance era.

“And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast”: they took the image from Rome, Caesar Borgia, the second son of Pope Alexander VI, and said this image shall now be called Jesus Christ. “That the image of the beast should both speak”: they find actors who look like Caesar Borgia to speak the words of Christ.

“And cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.” That is history. A sister with a talk show in Sierra Leone said nobody was killed for not worshipping the white image of Jesus; how little you know. Look at the king at the stake: the Jesuit priest held the cross with the white image of Jesus and told him if he worshipped the image he might go to heaven. He asked the priest where he would go when he died; the devil said heaven; and he said then I’d rather go to hell. They forced white-supremacy Christianity on us.

What is the mark? “To receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads: And that no man might buy or sell”. That lets you know the mark deals with economics, trade and commerce, traffic, doing business. It is not talking about a negro selling a Snickers bar or buying a KitKat; it is big business, corporations, Wall Street. “Save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.”

Who dictates buying and selling? The IMF, the International Monetary Fund, and the World Bank, right across the street from each other in Washington DC, and the New York Stock Exchange.

What they are selling: “And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her”. Merchants is not a modern word; the word for merchants today is corporations. “The merchandise of gold”: the negro ain’t selling gold, or silver. Most of these things come from the continent of Africa, and Central and South America too.

“And slaves, and souls of men.” These corporations were in the business of selling slaves: the Dutch West India Company, chartered in 1621 by Dutch merchants and foreign investors, was given jurisdiction over Dutch participation in the Atlantic slave trade in Brazil, the Caribbean and North America, and there was one on the eastern side too. Those companies didn’t go away; they just changed their names, into some of the biggest banks in the world. When we read the scriptures we must apply history to Bible prophecy.

“For in the hand of the Lord there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.” This cup of wine that the Lord has is judgment.

“Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz”: he is talking about the Edomites, the white folks. “The cup also shall pass through unto thee”: the cup we had to drink is going to be passed to your friendly neighborhood white man. “Thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.”

“The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion”: this proves Edom would be the ruling nation over us, because when God raises us up to the top, Edom goes down. It’s not Moab ruling, it’s not the Arabs ruling. “He will no more carry thee away into captivity”: that goes with Revelation 3, thou shalt go no more out; we ain’t going to be slaves ever again. “He will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.” Now it’s payback time.

More proof that Babylon is Edom, for the skeptics who thought Babylon was the Africans, Nebuchadnezzar, the Cushites. “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.” Rase means destroy it. “O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed”: he was calling Edom the daughter of Babylon. David saw this thing in the spirit, and John was repeating it to us.

You can make your money in the world and work your job, but there is a separation point: don’t bring him home to marry your sister or your brother.

Tormented with fire and brimstone: “But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise”: that’s destruction. “The earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up”: what is done in this country is all going to go bye-bye. Many of us want to keep the white man’s works, lying, stealing, bearing false witness, hatred, guile, deceit, and you are going to be burned up with your works.

“What manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness”: check yourself before you wreck yourself. Our conversation must not be filled with guile, deceit, trickery, hatred, murmuring against brothers and sisters. “Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness”: we look for a new kingdom on this earth.

“For, behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire. For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh: and the slain of the Lord shall be many.”

“And it shall come to pass, that in all the land”: land is singular, not plural; it is talking about Babylon first and foremost. “Two parts therein shall be cut off and die”: two out of every three of us ain’t no damn good, and it is talking about the Israelites, not Edom, not Moab and Ammon. So examine yourself day by day: am I murmuring, am I gossiping, do I have hatred for my brother or sister? Paul said in Philippians, not in my presence only but much more in my absence. That is why many on Facebook don’t want to be with a camp or a congregation: so nobody can check their wickedness. The two parts are the ones that say, Lord, we cast out devils in thy name, and he says depart from me ye workers of iniquity; the ones who leave and say stop teaching Christ was black, or you don’t have to keep Passover the way the Bible says.

“But the third shall be left therein. And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried”: a lot of brothers and sisters that bounce never get tried; they leave the fire before they are purified, before they get rid of the leaven, the bitterness, the envy, the malice. “They shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, The Lord is my God.”

“The same must know it after death by pain.” We think this life is it, but there is a spiritual world. When some are translated, I use that word instead of death, they are going to suffer major punishment. There is no escape; nobody gets away with nothing.

“And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet”: the false prophet is Christianity, the entire Christian system, that goes with the image that is worshipped. Christ said there shall be many false prophets. “That wrought miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast”: their science; that is how they do their miracles. “These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.” When the bombs hit this place it is going to be like a lake of fire. Those bombs aren’t sitting there for no reason; they are going to be used.

“He shall flee from the iron weapon”: the white man shall flee from the iron weapon, his bomb, his missiles, his ICBMs. “And the bow of steel shall strike him through”: the bow of steel is what we call a silo, holding the missile like a bow that is drawn back and lets go. “It is drawn, and cometh out of the body”: out of the earth. “Yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall”: the glittering sword is the missile.

“A fire not blown shall consume him”: you don’t have to blow on this fire; when the bombs hit, it is going to consume him. “It shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle”: the people who remain behind are ashes to ashes, dust to dust.

sense.text: “Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.” The key word is patience: we must patiently do what it says, because we get sick and tired sometimes of disciplining ourselves day after day. We wake up with evil on our minds, and through the day our minds start to wander.

“Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth”: this is a heavy verse; we don’t like talking about death. When brothers worry about traveling to other countries, anything could pop off: if we die, blessed are they that die in the Lord; keep pushing the truth. The Most High could take us out any time, anywhere in the world.

“That they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them”: the labors men and women do in this truth are for the Most High, not for pay from man. When a brother or sister dies, don’t bug out and say they must have been the devil. Tabitha died with good works; today they would say it was a blood sacrifice. Black people don’t read their Bible. The sister on the cruise jumped out of bed, screamed and fell down, and nothing could be done; she had a good report, and nobody found anything wicked to say about her. Her time was up.

precepts.why:
Those that die in the Lord: “Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.” We are going to have trouble on this earth, because everything for us here is a test to bring us to salvation, to the kingdom. “He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down”. “Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one”: if you are wicked as hell, we can’t make you clean.

“Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass”. God has your days and your months numbered; if he says you will live 46 years and 6 months, nobody can change that. So no matter what type of death a brother or sister has, don’t automatically think they were the devil. John the Baptist got beheaded; was he the devil? Their time was up.

Their works do follow them. This is for all of you that want to get paid: “For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name”: shown toward the word of God. Some of us think the Lord is going to forget, so we want payment from man, a Benjamin in my hand right now. That is not the true payment; the Lord said, I got you, I am going to give you power over the nations.

sense.text: “And I looked, and behold a white cloud”: a cloud chariot. Some of you have Greek mythology in your head and think Christ sits on a puff of smoke. “And upon the cloud one sat like unto the Son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.”
“Thrust in thy sickle, and reap: for the time is come for thee to reap; for the harvest of the earth is ripe.” This is all death and destruction for the wicked.

“Gather the clusters of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripe”, and they are cast “into the great winepress of the wrath of God.” Blood comes out of the winepress “even unto the horse bridles, by the space of a thousand and six hundred furlongs”: there is going to be so much death and destruction in the valley of decision.

The grapes gathered and smashed in the winepress are not the elect. It says gather: remember in Joel 3 he is going to gather the nations, and Zephaniah says his determination is to gather the nations, that he may pour upon them the fierceness of his anger.

precepts.why: The precept for the chariot, because somebody will say it is a cloud, not a chariot: “Who maketh the clouds his chariot”. What we call in America UFOs, the Bible calls clouds, or chariots.

Here is the precept: he is going to put in that sickle, the harvest is ready. “Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness is great.” Because their wickedness is great. “Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision.” This is all destruction.

Isaiah says the same thing about the grapes being crushed and smashed and reaped. “Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this that is glorious in his apparel”: when the Bible says Christ had on a white garment, it was glorious, not a sheet, not a toga; the most decked-out garment you can imagine.

“Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?” Like in Italy, where they go into the winepress and smash the grapes with their feet and the juice splashes everywhere: Isaiah is asking Christ in his vision why he looks like he just came out of crushing grapes.

“I have trodden the winepress alone”: I have killed the nations alone. “And of the people there was none with me”: no Israelites helping him. “For I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment. For the day of vengeance is in mine heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.”
